name: zcode-discord-rpc
description: Discord Rich Presence for ZCode: works out of the box (shared application built in) — shows your current project, what the agent is doing (thinking, running tools, waiting for input) and session time in your Discord profile. Linux, Windows, macOS; official Discord or Vesktop. Zero dependencies (Node only).

description_i18n.en: Discord Rich Presence for ZCode: works out of the box (shared application built in) — shows your current project, what the agent is doing (thinking, running tools, waiting for input) and session time in your Discord profile. Linux, Windows, macOS; official Discord or Vesktop. Zero dependencies (Node only).
description_i18n.ru: Discord Rich Presence для ZCode: работает сразу после установки (вшито общее приложение) — показывает текущий проект, чем занят агент (думает, запускает инструменты, ждёт ввода) и время сессии в профиле Discord. Linux, Windows, macOS; обычный Discord или Vesktop. Без зависимостей (только Node).
description_i18n.zh-CN: 适用于 ZCode 的 Discord Rich Presence：开箱即用（内置共享应用）——在 Discord 个人资料中显示当前项目、代理当前活动与会话时长。支持 Linux、Windows、macOS，兼容官方 Discord 或 Vesktop。零依赖（仅需 Node）。
